Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase redundantly combines a historical time period with another “time of” expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 孟子妈妈：孟子的妈妈，when a name modifies a kinship noun in this narrative style, use 的 to show the possessive relationship. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，here the mother notices the classmates’ influence; 看 means “look,” while 看到 expresses successfully seeing or noticing something. [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个叫孟子的小男孩；他很小的时候，孟子 is first introduced in this scene, so introduce him with a full noun phrase before using a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和他的妈妈搬家了，within the same noun phrase, repeat the name only once and use a pronoun for the already identified mother. [rule: redundancy_delete]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 同学们老是对他开玩笑了：同学们老是对他开玩笑，老是 describes a repeated habit, so it takes the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：因为他每天只祭拜，所以没有朋友，the relationship is cause and effect, so use the paired connector to link the reason and result. [rule: none]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
孟子妈妈 is an acceptable kinship expression, so adding 的 is unnecessary rather than a correction.
Here the mother notices an influence, so 看到 is the appropriate verb rather than 看.
孟子 is already a proper-name first mention, and the proposed replacement itself ends with the incomplete temporal phrase 他很小的时候.
Repeating 孟子 in 孟子和孟子妈妈 is redundant, and 孟子和他的妈妈 is a correct repair.
老是 describes a habitual action, so sentence-final 了 should be omitted.
Although-because does not express the intended causal relation; 因为……所以 correctly links the cause and result.
